summary: Independent read-only review of the refrozen specification and current design context. Separate source and target review stages, stage-specific subject rules, bounded arrays and free-text fields, and task-bound suggested mapping now address the preceding findings. The schema only validates a decoded envelope; raw byte handling, source-target matching and task writing remain E4.2. The frozen spec hash matches the review context and classification remains REVIEW/V1. This technical design approval is not owner spec approval, implementation authorization, verification or Gate.
